description: A contemporary, drum-shaped stool with a textured white fabric upholstery that covers its entire cylindrical body. The stool tapers slightly inwards from its flat top surface towards a wider base, which is finished with a dark, solid band. The fabric appears to have a subtle, woven pattern, adding a tactile quality to the design. Its minimalist form and neutral color make it a versatile piece that can blend into various interior settings. The stool sits on a plain, neutral background, emphasizing its clean lines and simple silhouette.
